ModMetaData.name: Caravans Critically Enhanced
ModMetaData.author: Zei33
ModMetaData.description: In development, and not yet released. So far it adds a Load work type next to Haul: colonists who are not going with a forming caravan help load it and lead its pen animals to it, and loading carries on while any listed item can still be fetched. When finished it will fix the other slow and fragile parts of forming a caravan as well: drafting will no longer drop a lead, cargo already on pack animals will stay listed, and the caravan will leave by an edge your allowed areas permit.
